title: Understand the reusable layer
when: When the same acceptance checks should apply repeatedly, or the user opens QA Plans to create/attach a plan.
need: A plan is an ordered set of case definitions; each case has a stable key, method, instructions and expected result. Attach a plan to a project default or one item when its checks must gate work.
surface: QA Plans tab; plan authoring/attachment; project command registration
gap: Public QA introduces tabs then jumps into binding commands. Review question: should a short worked method/case/plan example replace that conceptual gap?
